items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: But my mother insisted that I go to this other fella I mentioned, who was named Tony Bruno.

ctx.x: So I learned how to play that, then I learned how to play other songs, and then everyone called me “Little Satch” and I was the big thing around Pensacola. But my mother insisted that I go to this other fella I mentioned, who was named Tony Bruno. And he had been to New York. And one night he heard me play, and he said, “Why don’t you come by my house one day” and — you won’t believe this — he said, “Why don’t you come by my house one day and come to the front door” he said to me. During those days he said to me,…
